Subject: Satellite kiosk supply plan — banner & locker dimensions (approval needed)

Team —

We're confirmed for a satellite kiosk (10'x6' footprint) directly across from the main booth at CloudCon. Venue ops just gave us an option to rent a secure locker (lockbox) adjacent to the aisle for quick collateral restock. Before I commit budgets, I need signoff on a couple of things:

- Banner: Marissa, can you confirm the fabric banner final art and whether the pole/riser width will overhang the kiosk sightlines? We're limited to 8' height and 2.5' base depth.
- Locker sizing: Logan/Tessa, what are minimum internal shelving dimensions we should design for? Venue says locker interior is 48"W x 40"D x 78"H but we need to confirm acceptable crate sizes and weight limit.
- Access & scheduling: Tessa, confirm hourly access window for resupplies and if venue charges for repeated access.

I've attached a quick photo of the intended location in the hall plan (I'll upload the Drive link in follow-up). If we can get signoff today I can lock the banner order and reserve the lockbox.

Subject: Re: Satellite kiosk supply plan — banner & locker dimensions (approval needed)

Jordan / all —

Quick run-through from design: attached are two files — shelf_layout_v2.ai (shelving mockup with fold-flat crates) and fabric_banner_final.pdf (banner dielines). Key notes:

- Banner: final art fits the 8' height and the pole kit has a 30" base footprint; with the kiosk 6' deep we get ~6" of clearance at the back — that should be fine for sightlines. Recommend we use a low-profile pole (order code LP-30) to keep sightlines clean.
- Collateral crates: the shelf layout uses two 24"W x 18"D crate bays stacked; crates are 15" high when folded and 60 lbs loaded. If locker interior is 48"W x 40"D we can fit two stacks side-by-side.
- Weight: recommend limiting to 250 lbs per locker shelf to stay well under venue limits.

I flagged the banner for an alternate hem to allow quicker swaps between sessions. Lead time for the banner vendor is 5 business days once approved.

Attached: shelf_layout_v2.ai (design), fabric_banner_final.pdf (print-ready).

-Marissa
Sr. Designer, Events
Redwood Inference

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for the details. Confirming the lockbox specs you were quoted: interior 48"W x 40"D x 78"H, single-point keyed access, shelf spacing adjustable in 6" increments. Max distributed load 800 lbs; recommended per-shelf 300 lbs.

Access windows: exhibitor access is allowed during hall open hours and in a 60-minute pre-open window each morning (no overnight unattended access). Repeated badge access is £12 per swipe after the first 10 swipes/day (we charge per exhibition rules) — if you plan frequent restocks we can convert to a daily unlimited access pass for $85/day.

Attached is the exhibit_storage_policy.pdf with the formal sizes and the locker rental form. If you want me to reserve one for the north concourse near your kiosk, confirm the billing contact and we'll hold it for 48 hours.

Best,
